Esta Noche (gay bar) | Esta Noche was a gay bar located at 3079 16th & Mission Street in San Francisco, California.  It was the first gay Latino bar in San Francisco, and it was attractive to many people from the Latino community because it provided a space to drink, party, engage in hookup culture, organize and perform.  The bar first opened in 1979 and was the last Latino bar standing on 16th street by 1997.
